# Digital Bodleian

> > Digital Bodleian provides free online access to over a million digitized rare books, manuscripts, maps, and cultural treasures from the University of Oxford's world-renowned Bodleian Libraries.

Digital Bodleian is the primary digital repository for the Bodleian Libraries, offering comprehensive browsing and searching of medieval manuscripts, early modern archives, rare printed books, maps, portraits, and ephemera. The collection spans multiple languages and cultures, including Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Armenian materials, with many items available under Creative Commons licensing for research and reuse.

## Getting Started

- [Digital Bodleian](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk): Homepage showcasing over a million digitized rare books, manuscripts, and treasures from Bodleian Libraries.
- [Digital Bodleian | Browse](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/browse): Main collection browsing interface for digitized medieval and early modern manuscripts.
- [Digital Bodleian | About](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/about): About page describing Digital Bodleian's mission, partnerships, and digitization initiatives.

## Core Collections

- [Incunabula and Blockbooks](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/incunabula): Collection of early printed books including Gutenberg Bible and Pliny's Natural History.
- [Early Modern and Modern Rare Books](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/rare-books): Rare books collection featuring Shakespeare's First Folio and works by William Blake.
- [Western Medieval Manuscripts](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/western-medieval-manuscripts): Western medieval manuscripts from Duke Humfrey's Library and other Oxford donors.
- [Early Modern Manuscripts and Archives](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/early-modern-manuscripts-and-archives): Early modern manuscripts and archives including Tradescants' Orchard and John Aubrey papers.
- [Modern Manuscripts and Archives](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/modern-manuscripts-and-archives): Modern manuscripts and literary archives including Mary Shelley's Frankenstein papers.

## Specialized Collections

- [Maps and Atlases](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/maps): Maps and atlases collection including the historic Gough Map and cartographic materials.
- [Arabic Manuscripts and Maps](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/arabic): Arabic manuscripts and maps including collections from Archbishop Laud and Edward Pococke.
- [Hebrew Manuscripts and Printed Books](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/hebrew): Hebrew manuscripts and printed books including medieval and early modern texts.
- [Persian Manuscripts](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/persian): Persian manuscripts collection featuring poetry, Islamic art, and historical texts.
- [Armenian Manuscripts and Printed Books](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/armenian): Armenian manuscripts and illuminated books from New Julfa and medieval periods.
- [Portraits](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/portraits): Portrait collection featuring paintings, drawings, and prints from Oxford colleges.
- [Ephemera](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/collections/ephemera): John Johnson Collection of printed ephemera, playbills, and historical artifacts.

## Help & Support

- [Digital Bodleian | Help using Digital Bodleian](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/help): Help guide covering searching, advanced search, facets, and metadata viewing.
- [Digital Bodleian | Frequently asked questions](https://digital.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/faq): FAQs covering copyright, licensing, image downloads, and digitization status.
